Package edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.item

Class MapMilSymbolItem

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.item.AItem
edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.item.AMapItem
edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.item.MapPointItem
edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.item.MapMilSymbolItem
All Implemented Interfaces:
IFeedbackProvider, IDrawable, EventListener
public class MapMilSymbolItem extends MapPointItem
Map-native military symbol item.

The anchor position is stored geographically as longitude/latitude in radians, so the item stays attached to the same location when the map projection changes. The icon itself is drawn at a fixed pixel size for readability.

Context menu

In addition to the standard ordering/lock items inherited from AItem, the right-click menu includes an Edit Location… entry (after a separator) that opens a LatLongEditorDialog. If the user saves a new position the item is moved there and the map is refreshed; cancelling the dialog leaves the item unchanged.

      public Rectangle getBounds(IContainer container)
      Description copied from class: MapPointItem
      Returns the device-space bounding rectangle for this point item.

      For icon items: the rectangle is positioned according to the alignment settings. For symbol items: a square of size style.getSymbolSize() centred on the focus point.

      Returns null if the focus is unplaced or off-map.
